'''Couli''' was an [[Ensign/Legends|ensign]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. During the war, she sold modifications for people on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] at [[Vaiken Spacedock]].
